what_it_does: Finds the customer problem behind feature requests.
how_it_helps: Challenges premature solutions; tested by deferring an unvalidated AI dashboard.
reason: Turned an unvalidated AI request into a bounded onboarding experiment; slightly heavy discovery mechanics.
trial_evidence: Deferred AI dashboard; proposed cohort measurement and explicit evidence to revisit.

what_it_does: Chooses system boundaries and architectural tradeoffs.
how_it_helps: Supports defensible opinions; retained the monolith and addressed flaky tests.
reason: Rejected premature service extraction and tackled the actual fixture problem, with measurable extraction triggers.
trial_evidence: Modular monolith, fixture isolation, representative 10x load experiment.

what_it_does: Evaluates technology adoption and exit criteria.
how_it_helps: Resists novelty bias; required regional-read evidence before replacing PostgreSQL.
reason: Made an evidence-based Assess decision and accounted for exit cost; assessment staffing is somewhat heavy.
trial_evidence: PostgreSQL replica comparison, 3-year cost, recovery and export exit criteria.

what_it_does: Applies fundamental design and distributed-system principles.
how_it_helps: Catches expensive correctness bugs; designed safe payment retries.
reason: Strong distributed-systems reasoning: ambiguous outcomes, provider guarantees and finite replay safety.
trial_evidence: Durable logical payment ID, same provider key, bounded retries, reconciliation.

what_it_does: Sequences delivery, dependencies, validation, and recovery.
how_it_helps: Turns architecture into executable increments; planned compatible OIDC migration.
reason: Sequenced identity reconciliation before rollout and preserved old-client compatibility with realistic recovery.
trial_evidence: Internal tenant first; issuer/subject mapping; additive schema; gated cohorts and 90-day support.

what_it_does: Coordinates delivery across teams and dependencies.
how_it_helps: Exposes false-green status and missing ownership before deadlines slip.
reason: Exposed false-green reporting and converted cross-team dependencies into owned acceptance evidence.
trial_evidence: Blocked B's acceptance, demanded A staffing, protected C's freeze window and estimated D.

what_it_does: Plans and tracks work within a team.
how_it_helps: Passed, but overlaps implementation planning and program management.
reason: Passed, but duplicates implementation planning and program management.
trial_evidence: One ticket and early streaming-memory spike; no separate charter/RAG ceremony.

what_it_does: Bounds a useful release within fixed capacity.
how_it_helps: Cuts scope explicitly; reduced a workflow engine to sequential approvals.
reason: Bounds an open-ended request with exclusions and a stopping rule.
trial_evidence: Two sequential approvers; immutable submission snapshot; fixed three-week appetite.

what_it_does: Connects engineering investment to business direction.
how_it_helps: Makes a focused bet; distinguished enterprise pipeline from collected revenue.
reason: Chooses enterprise focus while separating qualified pipeline from cash.
trial_evidence: Paid-pilot gates; defers consumer expansion and standalone AI.

what_it_does: Prioritizes competing initiatives against capacity.
how_it_helps: Makes opportunity cost explicit; funded maintenance and SSO before redesign.
reason: Builds a feasible portfolio from capacity and quality of evidence.
trial_evidence: 18 engineer-weeks plus two reserved; maintenance and SSO first; search conditional.

what_it_does: Records decisions, alternatives, consequences, and revisit triggers.
how_it_helps: Preserves rationale; justified a PostgreSQL queue over Kafka.
reason: Records a restrained decision with operational consequences and revisit triggers.
trial_evidence: PostgreSQL email queue; explicit duplicate-delivery window; compares Kafka and hosted queue.

what_it_does: Reconstructs architecture from available evidence.
how_it_helps: Challenges misleading documentation and finds the smallest useful boundary.
reason: Uses code evidence over labels and proposes an incremental testable seam.
trial_evidence: Challenges README; separates worker import from runtime evidence; payment port before extraction.

what_it_does: Evolves public contracts without stranding consumers.
how_it_helps: Protects compatibility; planned exact-money APIs and conditional deprecation.
reason: Protects consumer compatibility and money correctness.
trial_evidence: Versioned exact-money representation; no fake precision from floats; conditional sunset.

what_it_does: Designs tenant boundaries and isolation economics.
how_it_helps: Prioritizes existing tenant leaks before expensive dedicated infrastructure.
reason: Prioritizes existing tenant leaks and preserves pooled-customer economics.
trial_evidence: Hybrid tenancy; unsafe paths disabled; tenant context and cross-tenant negative tests.

what_it_does: Explains layered, hexagonal, and domain-oriented patterns.
how_it_helps: Passed restraint test, but broader architecture guidance covers the same judgment.
reason: Passed using a minimal validation seam; broader architecture skill already covers this judgment.
trial_evidence: Rejected repositories/ports/CQRS as merge prerequisites.

what_it_does: Designs service boundaries and distributed operations.
how_it_helps: Correctly rejected extraction; keep only as a specialist reference.
reason: Correct refusal to split; specialized extraction reference adds little to the default staff toolkit.
trial_evidence: Index first, one deployable, operational ownership before extraction.

what_it_does: Separates command and query models.
how_it_helps: Correctly rejected CQRS; too specialized for the core shortlist.
reason: Correctly declined CQRS; useful only when this specialized implementation is warranted.
trial_evidence: One database and daily CSV; distinguishes CQRS from event sourcing.

what_it_does: Coordinates partial failure across distributed transactions.
how_it_helps: Recognizes irreversible actions; never promises to roll back nonrefundable purchases.
reason: Recognizes irreversible business actions and designs honest recovery.
trial_evidence: Nonrefundable flight is partial success; refundable action first; reconcile unknown outcomes.

what_it_does: Plans compatible schema changes and data backfills.
how_it_helps: Avoids destructive rollouts; preserved continuous writes and mixed app versions.
reason: Plans a continuous-write migration with old/new compatibility and honest rollback limits.
trial_evidence: Bidirectional synchronization, bounded backfill and locks, delayed contraction.

what_it_does: Handles dependency upgrades and breaking changes.
how_it_helps: Balances urgent CVE containment with compatibility and rollback.
reason: Balances urgent containment with breaking-change verification.
trial_evidence: Disable exposed upload route; isolate patched parser; preserve containment on rollback.

what_it_does: Investigates root causes through falsifiable hypotheses.
how_it_helps: Prevents guesswork; traced duplicate charges instead of extending timeouts.
reason: Tests a falsifiable root-cause hypothesis rather than applying a timeout bandage.
trial_evidence: Distinguishes request IDs from idempotency keys; traces durable operation identity.

what_it_does: Requires fresh evidence before declaring success.
how_it_helps: Prevents false completion claims after stale tests or failed commands.
reason: Refuses stale or failed verification evidence and gives a concrete path to a valid claim.
trial_evidence: Does not claim tested after dependency failure; requires fresh red/green and suite evidence.

what_it_does: Evaluates review feedback before applying it.
how_it_helps: Enables respectful pushback; rejected unsafe infinite payment retries.
reason: Pushes back on unsafe review advice with a viable alternative.
trial_evidence: Rejects infinite retries; durable repair states, bounded budgets, idempotent payments.

what_it_does: Prioritizes actionable code-review findings.
how_it_helps: Focuses on money loss and invalid inputs before naming preferences.
reason: Prioritizes monetary correctness over style and gives precise acceptance checks.
trial_evidence: Blocks separate transfer commits and negative amounts; distinguishes local and cross-system atomicity.

what_it_does: Builds regression tests before minimal fixes.
how_it_helps: Proves boundary behavior with deterministic tests rather than sleeps.
reason: Produces a minimal deterministic regression test and fix.
trial_evidence: Exact-expiry boundary fails before <= becomes <; adjacent boundary cases avoid false positives.

what_it_does: Creates detailed step-by-step implementation plans.
how_it_helps: Passed, but duplicated planning guidance and added speculative paths and stack.
reason: Correct half-day plan, but extra assumed paths/stack and procedural scaffolding duplicate the broader planning skill.
trial_evidence: Two tasks with invented-but-labeled TypeScript/PostgreSQL paths; migration/UI evidence included.

what_it_does: Clarifies intent and scales design discussion.
how_it_helps: Honored the trivial-change fast path; no distinct discovery benefit demonstrated.
reason: Passed safe bypass, but this trial demonstrates no additional discovery value beyond existing discovery/shaping coverage.
trial_evidence: Honors approved label change without reopening design; no edit or test falsely claimed.

what_it_does: Divides work by independence and shared state.
how_it_helps: Avoids conflicting agents; grouped shared-fixture failures and separated CSS.
reason: Delegates by dependency rather than counting failures.
trial_evidence: Auth and billing grouped around shared fixture; independent CSS parallel; combined validation.

what_it_does: Profiles bottlenecks and designs controlled experiments.
how_it_helps: Targets measured waste; chose query batching over a rewrite.
reason: Targets measured bottleneck and specifies a credible comparison.
trial_evidence: Batches 40 sequential queries; rejects unsupported Rust/Redis solution; controls workload and variation.

what_it_does: Uses query plans and indexes to improve SQL.
how_it_helps: Includes write cost and safe deployment, not just faster reads.
reason: Selects an appropriate conditional index and accounts for production cost.
trial_evidence: Partial tenant/created_at index for open orders; concurrency, WAL, write overhead and prepared plans.

what_it_does: Checks evidence and ownership before launch.
how_it_helps: Dropped for overhead: minimum-readiness request became eleven evidence categories.
reason: Correct no-go, but the minimum-readiness request became eleven evidence categories with many proposed owners and waiver gates.
trial_evidence: Three known blockers expanded into mandatory gaps including cost and unverified categories.

what_it_does: Connects reliability targets, alerting, and release policy.
how_it_helps: Challenges risky launches using an exhausted error budget.
reason: Connects launch risk to error budget and user-impact alerts, with explicit SLI assumptions.
trial_evidence: 43.2 minutes allowed; 50 consumed; defers risky release; replaces noisy CPU pages.

what_it_does: Defines user-centered reliability indicators and objectives.
how_it_helps: Measures completed exports; keeps stuck jobs in the denominator.
reason: Defines reliability around completed user outcomes and handles sparse events.
trial_evidence: Stuck jobs remain in deadline cohort; 56-miss 28-day budget; low-volume overdue alerts.

what_it_does: Defines incident mitigation, escalation, and recovery checks.
how_it_helps: Acts quickly without guessing recovery; tested flag mitigation and rollback timing.
reason: Prioritizes mitigation and proves recovery rather than declaring it from a changed flag.
trial_evidence: Disable discount flag early; timed rollback branch; cohort/error/payment verification.

what_it_does: Turns incidents into systemic, verifiable improvements.
how_it_helps: Avoids blame; proposed protocol tests, staging parity, and rollback rehearsal.
reason: Separates known contributing conditions from unproven root cause and assigns verifiable prevention.
trial_evidence: No blame on junior engineer; protocol gates, staging parity and rehearsed rollback.

what_it_does: Transfers incident context and next actions.
how_it_helps: Preserves ownership, restart deadlines, escalation triggers, and uncertainty.
reason: Transfers actionable ownership and preserves uncertainty during a live incident.
trial_evidence: 18:30 UTC restart; owner Alex; pending fix; queue headroom is not time to breach.

what_it_does: Plans and tests business-service recovery.
how_it_helps: Rejects green-backup complacency; checks actual RPO and RTO.
reason: Distinguishes completed backups from recoverable business service and tests explicit RPO/RTO.
trial_evidence: Nightly recovery misses 1h RPO; 7h restore misses 2h RTO; requires clean isolated timed drill.

what_it_does: Models demand, failure capacity, headroom, and cost.
how_it_helps: Caught the zone-loss deficit and calculated required pod counts.
reason: Calculates capacity under failure rather than healthy aggregate and prices headroom.
trial_evidence: 600 rps after zone loss; 14 pods minimum now, 18 next quarter; recommends 20 with spare-pod allowance.

what_it_does: Prioritizes cloud savings with operational constraints.
how_it_helps: Challenges arbitrary savings promises while protecting database memory and reliability.
reason: Prioritizes reversible savings while protecting memory and reliability; challenges an unsupported target.
trial_evidence: $24k target not guaranteed; 12% average CPU insufficient for cuts; 25% RAM cut implies ~93% utilization.

what_it_does: Follows requests across synchronous and asynchronous boundaries.
how_it_helps: Connects queue traces and prevents sensitive telemetry leakage.
reason: Connects the asynchronous request path and treats telemetry as a data exposure boundary.
trial_evidence: Queue context propagation, retry spans, latency boundaries, seeded PII absence checks.

what_it_does: Finds trust-boundary failures and prioritizes controls.
how_it_helps: Fixes authorization first; tests cross-tenant access and exposed download links.
reason: Fixes authorization before cosmetic hardening and addresses already exposed bearer links.
trial_evidence: Cross-tenant negative tests; existing signed URLs require revocation; no claim new expiry fixes old tokens.

what_it_does: Maps concrete threats to controls and verification.
how_it_helps: Selects signatures, deduplication, and safe SQL rather than an irrelevant VPN.
reason: Maps each concrete threat to a control and verification rather than prescribing irrelevant infrastructure.
trial_evidence: Signatures, freshness, durable deduplication, parameterized SQL; explains VPN limitations.

what_it_does: Minimizes data and designs retention and deletion.
how_it_helps: Collects only useful analytics and verifies deletion across derived stores.
reason: Matches collection to the actual analytics purpose and makes deletion verifiable; several policy defaults remain proposals.
trial_evidence: Drops reset-token URLs and unnecessary identifiers; bounded contributions, deletion propagation and restore tombstones.

what_it_does: Designs authentication, sessions, and authorization.
how_it_helps: Makes revocation real and addresses JWT, XSS, and CSRF tradeoffs.
reason: Specifies real revocation semantics and recognizes that cookies alone do not solve XSS or CSRF.
trial_evidence: Server-managed sessions; authoritative revocation; legacy JWT rejection; CSRF and XSS controls.

what_it_does: Builds tested, progressive deployment and recovery stages.
how_it_helps: Moves tests before exposure and separates additive from destructive migrations.
reason: Makes release safety depend on tested artifacts and schema compatibility rather than an approval checkbox.
trial_evidence: Tests before production; same immutable image; expand-contract; delayed destructive migration.

what_it_does: Builds internal platforms around developer needs.
how_it_helps: Targets database-access delays instead of mandating an unwanted portal.
reason: Treats a platform as a product and targets the actual customer bottleneck.
trial_evidence: Database-access pilot rather than mandatory portal; voluntary adoption, latency and stop criteria.

what_it_does: Creates task-oriented technical instructions.
how_it_helps: Explains replay hazards and checks without inventing command syntax.
reason: Documents operator decisions and consequences without inventing executable CLI flags; one referenced file is missing.
trial_evidence: Tenant/date preflight; preserves original payment keys; explicitly non-executable example and uncertain outcomes.

what_it_does: Verifies claims against independent, reproducible evidence.
how_it_helps: Catches semantic migration corruption that matching row counts misses.
reason: Tests meaning-preserving invariants using an independent oracle instead of matching counts.
trial_evidence: Exact money, timezone instants, identity mapping, full reconciliation and snapshot-bound evidence.

what_it_does: Audits generated code for hidden failure paths and debt.
how_it_helps: Passed, but duplicates code-review and secure-engineering checks; no distinct core benefit shown.
reason: Passed, but its generic failure-mode and dependency review duplicates code-review-excellence plus secure-software-engineering; no distinct core benefit demonstrated.
trial_evidence: Prioritized swallowed errors and tenant-negative tests before simplifying an unnecessary workflow engine.

what_it_does: Aligns team ownership with outcomes and flow.
how_it_helps: Tests shared outcome ownership; measures lead time instead of adding a coordination manager.
reason: Tests a change in outcome ownership instead of adding coordination overhead, with explicit capacity tradeoffs and guardrails.
trial_evidence: Reversible stream-aligned pilot; measures end-to-end lead time and impact on remaining teams.
